samples.question: The picture shows four round dials. Each dial has one short red mark on its rim and one black needle running out from its centre. A dial's READING is the angle you sweep clockwise, starting at that dial's own red mark and turning until you reach that dial's own black needle; it is between 0 and 360 degrees. The four dials do not share a red mark, so the direction a needle points on its own tells you nothing. Each dial is named by the colour of its ring: blue, green, purple or orange. The small grey square inside each dial is decoration and is never the zero mark. Which dial has the largest reading? Answer with its ring colour: blue, green, purple or orange.
